scripts.test: vitest run && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/core && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'git hooks installed from .githooks/'
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --git-dir > /dev/null 2>&1 && [ -z "$(git config core.hooksPath)" ] && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
